versions.changelog:
**Major update: Switch to AITUN/1 plain-TCP handshake for RDP routing (no TLS required).**

- Now uses plain-TCP handshake (AITUN/1, v4.9.22+) so multiple RDP tunnels share a single public port 3389, without TLS or per-user ports.
- Updated instructions to reflect the new "tcp-proxy" connection workflow for remote clients (using `aitun tcp-proxy -l`).
- Minimum required aitun version is now v4.9.22+; v4.9.23 recommended for clearer connection hints.
- Removed old TLS/SNI-based routing documentation, added details about using the plain handshake for subdomain routing.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify installation instructions; now recommends pip as the primary install method.
- Minor reordering and improvements to installation step for clarity.
- No user-facing functional changes.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Added pip-based installation method for `aitun` and updated install instructions accordingly.
- Metadata updated: now lists both pip and uv as supported install methods for `aitun`.
- Removed markdown file `skill-card.md`.
- No functional/logic changes to skill operation or usage instructions.

- Added installation instructions for Windows (PowerShell) in the setup section.
- No changes to core functionality; documentation updated for improved clarity and platform support.

- Switched recommended installation method to script (`curl -fsSL https://aitun.cc/install.sh | bash`) instead of `pip install`.
- Updated example `aitun` commands to use modern syntax (`-k YOUR_TOKEN --tcp-ports 3389`, decoupling `-p` from TCP-only mode).
- Clarified and simplified usage instructions for HTTP + RDP tunnel and TCP-only mode.
- Removed file: skill-card.md.
- Updated CLI reference and examples to reflect changes in flags and TCP routing behavior.

- Added version field to SKILL.md metadata.
- Updated install instructions to use `curl -fsSL https://aitun.cc/install.sh | bash` as primary method.
- Clarified usage of the `-p` flag and `--tcp-ports` for TCP-only mode in examples and CLI reference.
- Simplified example tunnel commands by removing unnecessary options.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

- Added skill version number (1.0.1) and reformatted metadata block in SKILL.md.
- Updated TCP tunnel instructions: now uses only `--tcp-ports` and `-k`, without requiring `-p` for RDP-only setups.
- Clarified the difference between TCP and HTTP tunnel usage in CLI examples and documentation.
- Updated CLI reference for clearer options, explaining TCP-only mode and `-p` flag usage.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
v4.7.0: All TCP requires TLS with SNI, updated for SSH-over-TLS architecture
Add range-based port allocation fallback (7000-7999) when requested port is occupied

Initial release of rdptunnel: expose local RDP servers to the public internet via aitun TCP tunnel.

- Provides a step-by-step guide to set up secure remote desktop access for Windows, Linux (xrdp), or VDI instances behind NAT/firewall.
- Supports advanced scenarios: custom RDP ports, concurrent SSH/RDP tunnel, Dockerized servers, and VNC-to-RDP bridging.
- Includes instructions for both server and client platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS).
- Lists security best practices and troubleshooting tips.
- Requires aitun with registered token for TCP forwarding.
- All traffic is encrypted end-to-end through the tunnel for added security.
